title: Screenshots
description: Capture player screenshots and recordings, and access Overwatch monitoring tools.

title: Suspicious players
description: View players flagged for suspicious activity and review their details.

title: Advanced tools
description: Use advanced player and weapon searches, and view search and screenshot logs.

title: Live map
description: View the live server map with player locations and details.

title: Lock bans
description: Lock and unlock bans, and edit or remove locked bans.

title: Edit player tags
description: Change the tags displayed on player profiles.

title: Loading screen
description: Add, edit, and remove loading screen images, including their descriptions and inclusion settings.

title: View queue
description: View players waiting in the server queue.

title: View Y
description: Delete posts from the in-game Y social feed.

title: Verify Y users
description: Add or remove verification status for Y users.

title: Edit Y
description: Edit the text and like count of Y posts.

title: Linked accounts
description: Investigate accounts linked through shared IP addresses, identifiers, or devices.

title: Announcements
description: Send in-game server announcements from the panel.

title: Damage logs
description: View damage logs and use damage analysis tools.

title: Explosion events
description: View recorded explosion events and their details.

title: Crafting logs
description: View crafting and item-combining recipes.

title: Phone logs
description: View in-game phone messages and call history.

title: Money logs
description: View records of in-game money activity.

title: Anti-cheat
description: View anti-cheat events, player detections, and detection statistics.

title: Dark chat
description: Read messages from the in-game dark chat.

title: Ban exceptions
description: Enable or disable ban exceptions for individual players.

title: Whitelist
description: Add or remove a player's whitelist status.

title: API tokens
description: Create, edit, and delete API tokens, and view their usage and request logs.

title: Edit realty
description: Edit property renters, rent amounts, payment dates, and key holders.

title: Savings logs
description: View savings account details and transaction history.

title: Bulk delete
description: Delete multiple player warnings in one action.

title: View inventories
description: View inventory contents, including item quantities and metadata.

title: Edit inventories
description: Add, edit, move, and delete inventory items, including their metadata. View inventories is also needed to see the items in the editor.

title: Divorce characters
description: End a character's marriage and clear the matching spouse's marriage record.

title: Revive offline characters
description: Clear an offline character's dead status so they are alive when next loaded.

title: Manage vehicles
description: Add vehicles to characters, edit vehicle details and ownership, and delete vehicles.

title: Edit ped model
description: Change the ped model used by a character.

title: Reset vehicle garage
description: Move a vehicle back to Garage C or fully reset its garage state, clearing impound status.

title: Suspicious entities
description: View suspicious entity spawn records and their details.

title: Edit company balances
description: Change a company's bank balance.

title: Edit savings balances
description: Change a savings account's balance.

title: View audit logs
description: View and filter the audit trail of actions performed through the panel.
